metadata.title: EAU Guidelines on Sexual and Reproductive Health
metadata.specialty: Urology, endocrinology, and sexual and reproductive health
metadata.summary: These guidelines address the medical aspects of sexual and reproductive health in adult men, including hypogonadism, sexual dysfunction, penile conditions, priapism, and infertility. They cover diagnosis, treatment, safety, follow-up, and survivorship. This 2025 edition is a limited update of the 2024 publication; its recommendations support individual clinical decisions rather than replace clinical expertise.

document_sections.heading: 1.1 Aims and Objectives
document_sections.content: The European Association of Urology (EAU) Sexual and Reproductive Health Guidelines address medical aspects of sexual and reproductive health in adult men. They reflect the best evidence available to the experts, but following their recommendations does not guarantee the best outcome for an individual patient. Clinical expertise remains necessary for treatment decisions, alongside consideration of each patient’s values, preferences and circumstances. The guidelines are neither mandatory nor intended to establish a legal standard of care.

document_sections.heading: 1.5 Summary of Changes
document_sections.content: For the 2025 update, relevant new evidence was identified, assembled and appraised through a structured literature assessment covering every guideline section. The update incorporated 76 updated studies. Section 5.4.4, concerning cardiovascular risk and sexual activity, was extensively revised and now includes figures 5.2 and 5.3. Section 5.6.12 gained two recommendations on treatment of ED. The recommendation concerning penile surgery for adult acquired buried penis was changed in section 9.3.2.2.5. Sections 11.3.5.4 on exome sequencing and 11.5.1.3 on probiotic treatment were added, and the recommendations in section 11.3.7 were updated.
